header: ROUND 9 - Advanced Algorithms at Scale: Distinct Substrings on 500k Chars
sub: Exact distinct-substring count (124,989,998,315) + longest repeated substring (185) on a 500,000-char text, stdlib only, under 60s. Naive is O(n^2) and hopeless. Verified against brute force on smalls and an independent suffix-automaton reference on the big file.
